summary: Iteration 4 (task enrichment) full pass. Backend: 38/38 pytest (29 regression + 9 new iter4). All new features verified end-to-end: detailed history entries (Prioritas/PIC/Judul/Tenggat), auto Tugas Selesai notification to PIC when items complete, Dokumen Balasan Baru notification to requester on new document response, @mention creates 'Anda disebut' for matching user, POST /tasks/{id}/duplicate produces '(Salinan)' with reset items/docs/status, templates CRUD (create from task_id / from scratch, list, instantiate, delete), PIC assignment returns pic_wa_url and creates 'Tugas Ditugaskan' notification, dashboard/stats returns workload (list of {name,count}) and 6-bucket trend (label,created,completed). Frontend E2E: Poppins applied on body, Dashboard shows 'Beban Kerja PIC' + 'Tren Mingguan' with 12 recharts bars, Tasks page has tabs (Semua/Tugas Saya/Menunggu/Berjalan/Selesai/Terlambat/Arsip), search, Prioritas/PIC/Sort selects, Kanban view renders all 4 columns, TemplateDialog creates and uses template (navigates to new task), TaskDetail has btn-duplicate-task/btn-save-template/btn-print-task, Duplikat navigates to new task titled '<title> (Salinan)', comment placeholder hints '@nama'.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/tasks.py _build_history correctly produces human-readable Indonesian diff strings for title/priority/pic/deadline; only title/priority/deadline compare against 'existing.get(...)' — for 'deadline' the entry is a generic 'Tenggat diperbarui' (no before/after). Consider showing old→new date for parity with priority/pic.
update_task: '_notify_response' fires whenever total response count increases, but not when responses are removed. Acceptable for now.
duplicate_task resets documents at task and item levels (correct), status=Pending, items done=false; keeps priority/description/requester/pic references from source — matches spec.
dashboard_stats trend uses now.weekday() offset per iteration; produces 6 correct week buckets ordered oldest→newest.
Tasks.jsx Kanban uses native HTML5 drag-drop (draggable+dataTransfer) — verified via API-level status change; drag automation not exercised.
TemplateDialog creates from-scratch only (name+items). Creating template from an existing task is only reachable from TaskDetail btn-save-template (verified button exists).
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed with TEST_/E2E_ (auto-cleanup in pytest). E2E left a few E2E_ tasks visible in Kanban screenshot (E2E_iter4_task, E2E_iter4_task (Salinan), E2E_iter4_tpl instance) — safe to purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter4 acceptance criteria met. Notification observation strategy: log in as the target user (budi/siti) and diff /api/notifications counts before/after action. pic_wa_url is populated only when body.pic changed (or on create). Duplicate uses window.confirm — Playwright accepts via page.on('dialog'). Kanban drag-drop not automated; verified column render + PUT status behavior via API tests.
